user.title: Arbor parent portal
user.description: Sign in with the same email address and password you use for the Arbor Parent Portal.

school.title: Choose a school
school.description: This Arbor account has children at more than one school. Add one school now; you can add the others afterwards.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate with Arbor
reauth_confirm.description: Arbor rejected the stored password for {email}. Enter the current password to reconnect.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Arbor. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.invalid_auth: Arbor did not accept that email address and password.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: That Arbor account is already set up for this school.

init.title: Arbor options
init.description: Arbor updates a few times a day at most, so there is little to gain from polling frequently. Arbor serves one day of timetable per request, so the timetable window is also how many extra requests each update makes per child.

data_description.calendar_days: Today plus the days after it. 7 covers the week ahead.

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Fetch the latest data from Arbor for every configured account.

dump_page.name: Dump page
dump_page.description: Return the structure of what a portal page serves, for reporting an issue when a sensor is empty. Values are omitted unless you ask for them.

include_values.name: Include values
include_values.description: Return the payload itself rather than just its structure. This will contain your child's personal data, so do not share it.
